connect.copyHint: Copy this text and send it to the agent
connect.instruction: Visit {{address}} and follow the steps there
connect.effect: This instruction tells the agent to install the Amane CLI and its skill.

token.title: About the token
token.body: If Amane is not on this machine, the agent will walk you through setting up the token via the CLI. If the desktop app is installed on this machine, the login command reads the token it left behind, so nothing to paste. The token is stored in the local config file and never appears in the conversation. Do not paste the token to the agent.

permission.title: Agent permissions
permission.body: The agent can perform every operation the built-in assistant can, and does so without approval. The skill instructs it to ask for your consent before any modifying operation, but that is a text-level constraint only. Use a model that follows instructions well; a careless one can lose data.

semantic.title: Semantic search
semantic.intro: Query covers and stills with natural language. Apart from the initial model download, no network is required; both image indexing and retrieval run entirely locally.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.intro: Embed a sample of covers and stills locally to measure image throughput and text query latency; nothing is written to the index.
benchmark.running: Running; results appear when it finishes

tips.title: Query tips
tips.elements: The model only understands elements visible in the image; plot, meaning and similar deeper context are out of scope.
tips.simple: Use simple words and a single attribute instead of stacking several attributes or directions.
tips.language: English descriptions may be more accurate than Chinese for the same meaning.
tips.positive: Avoid negative phrasing such as "not black hair"; describe the positive, e.g. "colored hair".
